test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

BG - FK - JO

NS - RW - VA
solution:
**The table is alphabet place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed is: 

**BG - FK - JO →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/babae53f11ca65afc9cd4fca2979b4d6e7903d4456941de35890663a719208f1.png] 

**NS - RW - VA →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ea55d9d109ceda03357832aec0a1921480db1ed52dab89ec90ed901df39232a.png] 

Similarly,

**DI - HM - LQ →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e56d9d5db1f23fc7fb1f23abd720872c4de6ccbea03629fa49e423c35561819c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"DI - HM - LQ".**
